display.purpose: The hero headline and the two halves of the inspection sentence. Two lines maximum.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the partner names list. Two lines maximum.

statement.purpose: Large paragraphs, quotes and row titles; 32px maximum, about three lines.

body.purpose: Running text, table values, buttons. Tabular lining figures.

label.purpose: Captions, table keys on small screens, the legal line.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Only the mobile menu panel, which floats over the page.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Headline line rises, reveals, rolling figures.

motion.name: ease-in-out

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action per screen: navy, square, with an arrow that nudges on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6em; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; font: 500 1.125rem/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; background: #0c3054; color: #fff; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #0a2744; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0c3054; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-arrow { transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary one (footer, mobile menu toggle).
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font: 500 0.9375rem/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; background: #f2f3f3; color: #2a2b2b; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #e4e6e7; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0c3054; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Particulars Table
components.description: The certificate's core device: every factual claim in a ruled key/value table.
components.css: .ds-part { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 1.125rem/1.5 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2a2b2b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-part th, .ds-part td { text-align: left; padding: 0.7rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd3d5; } .ds-part tr:first-child th, .ds-part tr:first-child td { border-top: 2px solid #2a2b2b; } .ds-part th { font-weight: 400; color: #565a5b; width: 40%; padding-right: 1rem; } .ds-part td { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Single-choice options in the enquiry slip; selected turns navy.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; font: 400 1.125rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; background: #f2f3f3; color: #2a2b2b; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #e4e6e7; } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { background: #0c3054; color: #fff; }

components.name: Underlined Field
components.description: Slip fields are written on a line, not boxed; focus turns the line navy and tints the field.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 500 1.125rem/1.5 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2a2b2b; } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #2a2b2b; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0 0.5rem; font: inherit; font-weight: 400; color: inherit; } .ds-field:hover { border-bottom-color: #0c3054; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #0c3054; background: #f2f3f3; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Plain bar: mark and two-line wordmark, five links with a growing underline, one navy action.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; font: 400 1.125rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2a2b2b; background: #fff; padding: 1rem 2rem; } .ds-word { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.15; color: #565a5b; margin-right: auto; } .ds-word b { font-weight: 500; color: #2a2b2b; } .ds-link { position: relative; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; padding: 0.6rem 0; } .ds-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.35rem; height: 2px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-link:hover { color: #0c3054; } .ds-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-cta { background: #0c3054; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: The site is issued like a commodity certificate. Claims sit in ruled particulars tables; the company's own site photographs are the proof. The hero is a navy field beside a full-height site photograph. Colours come straight from the Mgabhi logo: white paper, charcoal ink, navy issuer ink.
keyCharacteristics: Split hero: navy field with the headline, full-height site photo
One family, Hanken Grotesk 400/500, tabular figures
Real ruled tables are the only lines on the page
Motion: headline lines rise, sections reveal once, figures roll

rules.name: Certify, don't claim
rules.body: Every factual claim lives in a particulars table, never in a floating badge or a stat tile.

rules.name: Issuer ink
rules.body: Navy marks the issuer: the hero field, the action, the selected state, and the certified figures.

rules.name: Two lines
rules.body: Every headline holds two lines at every width; longer copy becomes a statement paragraph.

dos: Do use the company's own photographs, square-cropped, captioned plainly
Do spell the name Mgabhi & Famaly Construction Pty Ltd
Do keep the stats to the confirmed four: 10+ years industry experience, 100% safety compliance, 5 regions, 4 verticals
donts: Don't use stamps, seals or badges
Don't add eyebrows above headings, icon cards, gradients, glass or resting shadows
Don't invent clients, tonnages, grades or quotes
Don't use official partner logos without approved files
